business_problem: KFH turned to its long-time partner Microsoft and consolidated data from all its subsidiaries onto KFH data center powered by Microsoft services. This enabled the bank to use Microsoft Fabric to process large amounts of raw data, structure it, and move it to Microsoft data warehouse. KFH didn’t just want a centralized system—it also wanted to have more advanced data analytics.
solution_summary: KFH turned to its long-time partner Microsoft and consolidated data from all its subsidiaries onto KFH data center powered by Microsoft services. This enabled the bank to use Microsoft Fabric to process large amounts of raw data, structure it, and move it to Microsoft data warehouse. KFH unified its data and developed ‘RiskGPT’ using Microsoft AI solutions for advanced risk analytics. This in-house AI engine was developed in collaboration with the research and development (R&D) institute. As a result, evaluating credit cases takes an hour instead of three days. Real-time reports leveraging Microsoft Fabric enabled more strategic decision-making and value creation. solution_components.name: Microsoft Fabric
solution_components.role: Hosts the unified lake, warehouse, and analytics environment used to consolidate and model enterprise data.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics to business users.

solution_components.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
solution_components.role: Surfaces generative AI assistance inside Microsoft 365 apps for drafting, summarization, and knowledge retrieval.

data_flow: Data moves from connected source systems into Microsoft Fabric, where it is transformed, modeled, and stored for governed access before being served to business users through Power BI dashboards.
business_outcome: Senior leadership has embraced this effort. “When we first discussed introducing AI and automation into risk management and presented a basic proof of concept to the board, they quickly saw its strategic potential and gave us full support to move forward,” recalls Albendari. “The IT department also embraced our ambition and provided us a support facilitating the implementation of AI technologies.” Today, senior managers see risk management as a vital part of strategic decision-making.
